title: A Reckoning on the High Street
description: You have cost the Syndicate its collectors, its bank, its patrols, its closers, and its badges. Now they mean to make the High Street an example — every crew they have left, Legbreakers and Gunsels and Torpedoes and the last bought Constables, massing for one show of force. The sergeant stands with you this time, in the open, in daylight. Break them here and the rift-echo that made these men kings loses its throne. Leave nothing standing.
location_hint: The whole of Ashmoor High Street, at noon

objectives.desc: Drop the Torpedoes leading the charge
